summary:
Billing race and invoice pagination fixes are complete, committed, tested, and lint-clean. Invoice report performance was optimized through per-account aggregation and batched currency conversion: tenant 73 now runs in about 4.27s with 37 queries; all 63 report tests pass (2 skipped). AWS VPC peering connection `pcx-0a9b8c7d6e5f40312` was accepted; verification remains.

The active schema is `billing_v3`; never write to frozen `billing_v3`’s predecessor `billing_v1`.

Invoice PDF work is in progress. Negative credit lines are now retained and placed after related items; shared `format_money()` provides grouped currency output. New formatting tests pass and Ruff is clean. A page-height helper was introduced, but the new 86-item regression test still fails because rendering produces 3 pages instead of expected 2, with totals wrapping incorrectly.

SQLAlchemy 2.0 work is explicitly on hold. The next priority is a vendor-credit CSV importer in `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`. Terraform’s 120-line config/deploy file limit must be preserved.
